description: The towns and suburbs in the Western Cape where WRDO has listings, each with its region and how many businesses (suburbs counted in their town). Gives the valid names for "where" in search_local_businesses and list_categories. Optional "query" keeps areas whose name or region contains it (e.g. "paarl" or "winelands"). Most businesses first, up to 100; areas with none are left out. Western Cape only. Names and counts only: no business or contact details.

query.description: Part of a town, suburb or region name, e.g. "paarl" or "cape town". Leave out for every area.

name: list_areas

name.description: Use as "where" in search_local_businesses and list_categories.

total.description: How many areas match, before the cap on this list.
